subject.title: feat(ui): path-based session and dashboard URLs

question: Should OpenClaw preserve released query-form session links during the path-URL rollout, and should the URL contract be packaged as a dependency consumable by ClickClack rather than duplicated?
rationale: The branch deliberately makes a compatibility break and its current package boundary cannot deliver the claimed single executable contract to an independently published plugin; those are product and ownership choices, not routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Migrate existing links and publish one contract
options.body: Keep path URLs canonical, redirect or translate the released query form, and expose the formatter/parser through a dependency boundary that ClickClack can import.

options.title: Accept a clean URL break
options.body: Merge without legacy-link support only after explicitly accepting bookmark and ClickClack history breakage, while still choosing a permanent shared-contract ownership model.

options.title: Defer the rollout
options.body: Pause the path-URL feature until URL migration and plugin packaging direction are agreed.

recommendation.title: Migrate existing links and publish one contract
recommendation.body: Keep path URLs canonical, redirect or translate the released query form, and expose the formatter/parser through a dependency boundary that ClickClack can import.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active implementation and can provide the architectural context, although current-main ownership history could not be independently inspected.
